claim_text: Creatine supplementation has stronger evidence for repeated high-intensity exercise and strength/power outcomes than for pure steady-state endurance performance; benefits should not be generalized across exercise modalities.
health_goal_or_outcome: Avoid unsupported product claims and align recommendations with evidence and individual context.
ingredient_form_or_preparation: Relevant dietary or supplemental forms; verify exact formulation and label.
evidence_summary: NIH ODS Exercise and Athletic Performance fact sheet reviews creatine evidence by exercise outcome and modality.
limitations: No endurance-specific dose or performance benefit established by this claim.
